result.detail: Spec deviations and gaps, recorded so they are visible. (1) Section 7 of the interface spec asks for a formal proof, and the microarchitecture lists sync_fifo.sby and sync_fifo_depth5.sby. I am not submitting a formal_spec file in this task because the expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench, so formal.run and formal.cover will not apply. The properties under `ifdef FORMAL` are unproven, and the anyconst data-integrity check still needs to be added, as follow-up work for a formal task. (2) The microarchitecture also lists a failure-path testbench, sync_fifo_tb_fail.v. It is not delivered here; it is follow-up work. (3) No `timescale is used in either file, which avoids a TIMESCALEMOD mismatch. (4) Policy choices follow the spec exactly: a write when full is dropped, a read when empty is ignored, and when full a simultaneous write and read accepts only the read.
